title: Release Notes Template
description: Downloadable release notes templates: a blank release note, a filled SaaS example with release metrics, a hotfix format, and a conventional-commit to release-note mapping cheat sheet.
description_es: Plantillas de release notes descargables: una nota en blanco, un ejemplo SaaS completo con métricas de release, un formato de hotfix y una chuleta de conversión de conventional commits a entradas.
